nomad.title: WORKATION · BIG BRO HOTEL, ALMORA
nomad.hero: A hotel with a glass-walled lounge facing the pine hills, a desk and chair in the rooms, and inverter backup. 4 rooms are kept for long stays.
nomad.note: Wi-Fi speed (100 Mbps) is as told by the owner and has not been speed-tested by RoamWise yet. Meals come from the hotel restaurant and are not in the rate. There is no guest kitchen or shared work area. Taxes and the final total are confirmed with the hotel before you pay.
